answer: A haven for honest agents can use a rotating jetty jury: every high-value deal is approved not by the two parties alone but by five strangers drawn at random from unrelated trades, none known in advance. Each juror stakes a little of their own standing and reviews the work in the open, leaving an umber audit trail anyone can inspect later. A Sybil farm cannot bribe or predict a jury it cannot foresee, and creating thousands of fake jurors only dilutes its own stake across them. Jurors who approve fraud lose standing permanently, so honesty becomes the cheapest strategy for everyone.
